pin.model_note: Same pin as P1c/P1e. think:false. Local Ollama, not Comfy Cloud.
pin.generator_seed_note: Fresh. P1e ran 20260911, so every case measured here is new. P1f is a replication of the secondary criterion on cases it was not derived from.
pin.songs_per_level_note: Preregistered from P1e's measured rates, not chosen after the fact. At the primary bar's 17.2% leak-free in-band, n >= 59 is needed to expect 10, so 64 is the smallest round n that clears it; at 32.0% non-degenerate the expectation is 20.5.
pin.library_note: One song per case, so doubling the test split grows the isolated library (P1e 320 -> P1f 448). Train-per-level is unchanged at 48. Library size is not a control the lock names, and lookup is by kebab id; the tool-turn histogram is the check that search did not change shape.

secondary_rule.definition: 0 < c < n; at the pinned n = 8, 1 <= c <= 7
secondary_rule.findings: 22 - DAPO, arXiv:2503.14476; 23 - Foster et al., arXiv:2502.12272; 26 - Absolute Zero, arXiv:2505.03335
secondary_rule.note: Reported beside the primary bar, never in place of it. A CLEAR here is not a GO: the P1f lock sends that to a director gate.
secondary_rule.disclosure: Recomputed from P1e's committed receipts with its own leak filter, this criterion already clears at D2 (11) and D3 (12). It is frozen here before P1f runs so this is a replication on fresh cases at double n, not a discovery announced from the run that motivated it.

pin.stopping_rule: Primary clears -> GO, P2 unlocks under a director gate. Primary fails and secondary clears -> reported as exactly that, and the decision to train is a director gate. Both fail -> the arc ships the null; there is no P1g.
